heroHeadline: Day 664: Morena Senator Inzunza Cazárez Surrenders to US in San Diego — Three of Ten SDNY-Indicted Sinaloa Officials Now in Brooklyn Federal Detention
heroSubtitle: 664 days of cartel civil war — May 17: Morena Senator Enrique Inzunza Cazárez (53), former Secretary General of Sinaloa state and alleged direct Chapitos-Rocha Moya intermediary, surrendered to US federal authorities in San Diego — the third of the ten SDNY-indicted officials to face US justice, following Mérida Sánchez (May 11/15) and Díaz Vega (May 15). Inzunza allegedly provided Chapitos with political opponents' home addresses before the 2021 election and embedded cartel-aligned officials throughout Sinaloa's state government. All three are held at Brooklyn MDC; seven officials including Rocha Moya and Culiacán Mayor Gámez Mendívil remain in Mexico as FGR's extradition review continues on Day 19. Separately: NGO Sabuesos Unidas reports ~5,800 disappearances in Sinaloa since September 2024 — nearly triple earlier Noroeste tallies. El Mayo sentencing before EDNY Judge Cogan set July 20, 2026; La Mayiza ~90% territorial control; 13,300+ federal troops in Sinaloa; war toll ~2,425+ homicides since Sep 9, 2024.
